scripts.test: pnpm run test:review-readiness && pnpm -r run test
scripts.build: pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm -r run build
scripts.db:bootstrap: mr="${MIGRATION_ROLE:-}"; case "$mr" in "") ;; *[!a-zA-Z0-9_]*) echo "MIGRATION_ROLE must be a plain identifier: letters, digits, underscore only" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; psql "${DATABASE_URL_MIGRATION:?DATABASE_URL_MIGRATION is required}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SET job_definer_bootstrap.migration_role = '$mr'" -f infra/postgres-init/01-job-definer.sql && psql "${DATABASE_URL_MIGRATION:?DATABASE_URL_MIGRATION is required}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SET chat_definer_bootstrap.migration_role = '$mr'" -f infra/postgres-init/02-chat-definer.sql
